title: Walk SE under the DESIGN LOCK: lean deterministic pipeline (milestone 1, round 2: Amendment 1)
question: Can one lean pipeline (rig copy, 10 springs, 14-colour 2-tone palette, vector outline, overlap-only interior lines, eyes+brows stamps) produce walk SE that passes every lock gate, and how far is it from the gold frames?
method: pipe/build_walk_se.sh (~35 s, deterministic). Rig r13 copy with narrower sleeves, a waist step at the obi, a flat-skin face and a solid bow. Walk re-baked through M's mbuild with 10 simulated spring bones. 8x guide/part/normal/depth passes. lock_chain.py: N.L 2-tone ramps on the 14 lock keys, a vector-line outline with part-wise temporal vertex hysteresis and dezig/polish, far-side K only at the listed overlaps, facesys b' eyes at the tracked surface point. Gates: lamet line, palette, P's limb audit, M's posture gate, gifcheck. Round 2 (Amendment 1): SE body yaw cheat -15 deg with head -10 (yaw_sweep.py, rest IoU vs EC0_SE_96); rig-copy edits toward the master (head x1.10, visible neck and collar V, full-width obi band, mid-shin boots, side locks stretched x1.7 and waved); temporal snap that follows surface points (new rpos pass) and also the next frame's line.
result: All blocking gates PASS (round 2): zigzags <= 1, L-corners 0, gaps 0, clumps 0, stray interior K 0, <= 12 colours, 0 off-lock or cross-material, limbs 8/8, posture PASS, GIF ok. Report only: boil .0282, shade_swap .0090. Single-frame outline pops: 100 -> 81 on the part-shift metric, 26 on the flow metric (round-1 method on the new rig: 94/27). Yaw sweep: rest silhouette IoU vs the master is flat from -5 to -15 (.79-.77) and falls at -20/-25 (.755/.732), so -15 was chosen. Head-band width 35 px = master. Gold v2 (17:39 version): sil IoU .70 (f00) / .61 (f02), up from .63/.56 against v1; 1583/1674 px differ.
verdict: On-lock and closer to the master's head, neck, collar, locks and boots. The gold gap is now mostly pose (gold v2's drawn arm, skirt and knee) and garment volume, which need motion keys or a lock decision rather than overrides.
